zfs allow -s @poolset create,mount syngoidfx (rc=0)
zfs allow -g sgxgrp mount syngoidfx (rc=0)
zfs allow -u sgxuser snapshot,hold syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -g sgxgrp send syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -e bookmark syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -s @set1 create,mount,receive syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -l -u sgxuser release syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -d -g sgxgrp destroy syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -l -d -u sgxuser @set1 syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -c create,mount,snapshot syngoidfx/fx/a (rc=0)
zfs allow -l -u sgxuser rename syngoidfx/fx/a/c (rc=0)
